patterns.title: Placeholder Content
patterns.description: App contains placeholder text, images, or Lorem Ipsum
detection: Look for 'Lorem ipsum', 'TODO', 'placeholder', 'test data', 'sample' in user-facing strings and Info.plist values
patterns.fix: Replace all placeholder content with final copy before submission.
patterns.example_before: let welcomeText = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet"
patterns.example_after: let welcomeText = "Welcome to MyApp! Get started below."

patterns.title: App Crashes on Launch
patterns.description: App crashes during startup or within first interaction
detection: Check for force-unwrapped optionals in initialization code
Look for missing required resources referenced at startup
Check deployment target matches minimum supported device
patterns.fix: Test on physical devices with clean install. Use crash reporting tools.

patterns.title: Broken Links or Features
patterns.description: Non-functional buttons, dead links, or features that don't work
detection: Check for URLs in code/plist that may not resolve
Look for stub/empty action handlers
Check for features gated behind flags that may be disabled
patterns.fix: Test every link and button in the app. Remove or hide features that aren't ready.

patterns.title: Missing Demo Credentials
patterns.description: Login-required app without demo account in review notes
detection: Check if app has login screen or authentication flow
Look for Auth/Login related code
Verify if demo credentials are mentioned in App Store review notes
patterns.fix: Provide working demo credentials in App Review Information notes in App Store Connect.

patterns.title: Missing Privacy Policy
patterns.description: No privacy policy URL provided or URL is broken
detection: Check Info.plist for privacy policy URL
Verify App Store Connect metadata includes privacy policy link
patterns.fix: Add a working privacy policy URL to both Info.plist and App Store Connect.
patterns.example_before: <!-- No privacy policy URL in Info.plist -->

patterns.title: Data Collection Without Disclosure
patterns.description: App collects data not declared in privacy nutrition label or privacy manifest
detection: Look for analytics SDKs (Firebase, Mixpanel, Amplitude) in project
Check if PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy exists and declares all tracking
Compare declared data types vs SDK capabilities
patterns.fix: Update your App Store Connect privacy nutrition label and PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy to declare all data types collected.

patterns.title: Missing Privacy Manifest
patterns.description: App lacks PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy file required since iOS 17
detection: Check for PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy in project root
Look for required reason APIs (UserDefaults, fileTimestamp, diskSpace, etc.) that mandate the manifest
patterns.fix: Create a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy file declaring your privacy practices and required reason API usage.

patterns.title: Vague Permission Usage Strings
patterns.description: NSUsageDescription strings are generic or don't explain why the permission is needed
detection: Check Info.plist for NS*UsageDescription keys
Flag generic strings like 'This app needs access to your camera'
Check if usage strings explain the specific feature
patterns.fix: Write specific usage descriptions that explain exactly why your app needs each permission and what feature uses it.
patterns.example_after:
<key>NSCameraUsageDescription</key>
<string>Take photos to add to your meal diary and track your nutrition progress.</string>

patterns.title: Unused Permission Requests
patterns.description: App requests permissions it doesn't visibly use
detection: Check Info.plist for permission keys (NSCameraUsageDescription, NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription, etc.)
Verify each permission has a visible corresponding feature
Flag permissions that seem unrelated to app's purpose
patterns.fix: Remove permission requests that aren't necessary for your app's core functionality.

patterns.title: Screenshots Don't Match App
patterns.description: App Store screenshots show features or UI that don't exist in the app
detection: Compare App Store description claims vs actual feature set
Check for marketing copy that overpromises
patterns.fix: Update screenshots and descriptions to accurately reflect the current app experience.

patterns.title: References to Other Platforms
patterns.description: App or metadata mentions Android, Google Play, Windows, or other platforms
detection: Search strings, descriptions, and UI for 'Android', 'Google Play', 'Windows Phone', 'Amazon'
Check in-app text and onboarding flows
patterns.fix: Remove all references to competing platforms from your app and metadata.

patterns.title: Missing In-App Purchase
patterns.description: App offers digital content/features purchasable outside of Apple's IAP system
detection: Look for external payment SDKs (Stripe, PayPal) for digital goods
Check for links to external purchase pages for premium features
Verify physical goods vs digital goods classification
patterns.fix: All digital content and feature unlocks must use Apple's In-App Purchase system.

patterns.title: No Restore Purchases
patterns.description: App with IAP missing a 'Restore Purchases' button
detection: Check if app has In-App Purchases
Look for restore purchase functionality
Verify presence of restore button in settings or purchase screens
patterns.fix: Add a clearly visible 'Restore Purchases' button accessible from your app's settings or purchase screen.

patterns.title: Unclear Subscription Terms
patterns.description: Auto-renewable subscription pricing, renewal terms, or cancellation instructions not clearly disclosed
detection: Check for subscription-related code
Look for subscription disclosure text near purchase buttons
Verify trial period disclosures
patterns.fix: Clearly display subscription price, renewal period, and free trial length before the purchase button. Include a link to manage subscriptions.

patterns.title: Missing Sign in with Apple
patterns.description: App uses third-party login (Google, Facebook, etc.) without offering Sign in with Apple
detection: Check for third-party auth SDKs (Google Sign-In, Facebook Login, etc.)
Look for login UI with social login buttons
Verify if Sign in with Apple capability is in entitlements
patterns.fix: If your app offers third-party login options, you must also offer Sign in with Apple as an equivalent option.

patterns.title: Missing App Tracking Transparency
patterns.description: App uses IDFA or tracking SDKs without ATT prompt
detection: Check for AdSupport framework
Look for tracking SDKs (Facebook SDK, Google Ads, etc.)
Verify ATT framework usage in Info.plist (NSUserTrackingUsageDescription)
patterns.fix: Implement AppTrackingTransparency framework and request permission before any tracking.
patterns.example_after:
<key>NSUserTrackingUsageDescription</key>
<string>We use this to deliver personalized ads that match your interests.</string>

patterns.title: Design Spam / Low Quality
patterns.description: App is too similar to existing apps or provides minimal unique value
detection: Check if app is essentially a web wrapper (WKWebView-heavy)
Look for very minimal native UI
Verify the app provides functionality beyond a website
patterns.fix: Ensure your app provides unique value and native functionality that goes beyond what a mobile website offers.

patterns.title: Minimum Functionality
patterns.description: App doesn't have enough features to qualify as a standalone app
detection: Evaluate if app is essentially a single web view
Check if app is a thin wrapper around a website
Verify app has native navigation and features
patterns.fix: Add enough native functionality that your app stands on its own as a proper iOS app, not just a web bookmark.

patterns.title: Private API Usage
patterns.description: App uses private or undocumented Apple APIs
detection: Check for method swizzling of system classes
Look for use of underscore-prefixed APIs
Check linked frameworks for private frameworks
patterns.fix: Replace all private API usage with public API equivalents. Apple frequently rejects apps using undocumented APIs.

patterns.title: Improper Background Mode Usage
patterns.description: App declares background modes it doesn't legitimately use
detection: Check Info.plist UIBackgroundModes array
Verify each declared mode is actually used (audio, location, voip, fetch, remote-notification, bluetooth, etc.)
Flag background modes that don't match app's purpose
patterns.fix: Remove background mode declarations that your app doesn't legitimately use. Apple verifies these.

patterns.title: Missing Content Moderation
patterns.description: App with user-generated content lacks reporting/blocking features
detection: Check for UGC features (chat, posts, comments, photos)
Verify report/flag mechanism exists
Look for user blocking capability
patterns.fix: Implement content reporting, user blocking, and content filtering for any user-generated content features.

patterns.title: Misleading App Description
patterns.description: App Store description doesn't accurately describe what the app does
detection: Compare stated features in description vs actual capabilities
Check for exaggerated claims
patterns.fix: Update your App Store description to accurately and honestly describe your app's features.

patterns.title: Missing Location Usage Justification
patterns.description: App requests location access without clear justification for the specific permission level
detection: Check for NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription vs NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription
Verify 'Always' location isn't requested when 'When in Use' would suffice
Check if background location is declared but not essential
patterns.fix: Use the minimum location permission level needed. Provide clear justification for 'Always' access if required.

patterns.title: IPv6 Incompatibility
patterns.description: App doesn't work on IPv6-only networks (Apple tests on IPv6)
detection: Check for hardcoded IPv4 addresses in code/config
Look for direct socket connections that may not support IPv6
Verify use of higher-level networking APIs (URLSession) vs raw sockets
patterns.fix: Use high-level networking APIs (URLSession, Network.framework) that handle IPv6 automatically. Don't hardcode IP addresses.

patterns.title: Missing iPad Support or Poor Layout
patterns.description: Universal app has broken layout on iPad or doesn't support all orientations properly
detection: Check Info.plist for device family support (UIDeviceFamily)
Look for iPad-specific layout constraints or size classes
Check UISupportedInterfaceOrientations for iPad
patterns.fix: If your app claims Universal support, ensure it works properly on iPad with appropriate layouts.

patterns.title: App is Primarily Marketing Material
patterns.description: App is essentially an advertisement or marketing brochure
detection: Check if app primarily displays company info/promotional content
Look for minimal interactivity
Verify app has core functionality beyond marketing
patterns.fix: Ensure your app provides genuine utility or entertainment beyond promoting your brand or services.

patterns.title: Missing Required Icons
patterns.description: App icon missing for required sizes or doesn't follow Apple's icon guidelines
detection: Check Assets.xcassets for AppIcon set
Verify all required icon sizes are present
Check for transparency in icons (not allowed)
patterns.fix: Provide app icons at all required sizes. Icons must not have transparency or alpha channels.

patterns.title: Contacts Access Without Clear Need
patterns.description: App requests contacts permission without obvious feature requiring it
detection: Check for NSContactsUsageDescription in Info.plist
Verify app has a clear contacts-related feature
Flag if contacts permission seems unrelated to app purpose
patterns.fix: Remove contacts permission if not essential. If needed, clearly explain the specific feature that requires it.

patterns.title: Copyright/Trademark Infringement
patterns.description: App uses copyrighted material, trademarks, or brand names without permission
detection: Check app name and description for trademark terms
Look for third-party brand logos/images
Verify licensing for any third-party content
patterns.fix: Remove all unauthorized use of trademarks, copyrighted material, and brand assets. Get written permission for any third-party content.

patterns.title: Deprecated APIs or Frameworks
patterns.description: App uses deprecated APIs that may cause issues or future incompatibility
detection: Check deployment target vs SDK version
Look for usage of deprecated frameworks (UIWebView, AddressBook, etc.)
Check for build warnings about deprecations
patterns.fix: Replace deprecated APIs: UIWebView → WKWebView, AddressBook → Contacts framework, etc.

patterns.title: Missing Required Reason API Declaration
patterns.description: App uses required reason APIs without declaring them in privacy manifest
detection: Check for usage of UserDefaults, fileTimestamp, diskSpace, systemBootTime APIs
Verify these are declared in PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy with approved reasons
patterns.fix: Add required reason declarations to your PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy for all required reason APIs your app uses.

patterns.title: Missing Push Notification Entitlement
patterns.description: App references push notifications but lacks the push entitlement
detection: Check for push notification code (UNUserNotificationCenter)
Verify aps-environment entitlement in .entitlements file
Check if push notification capability is enabled in entitlements
patterns.fix: Enable Push Notifications capability in Xcode and ensure your entitlements file includes the aps-environment key.

patterns.title: External Payment Links for Digital Goods
patterns.description: App links to external website for purchasing digital content
detection: Check for URLs that lead to payment pages
Look for 'subscribe', 'upgrade', 'premium' text linked to external URLs
Verify digital vs physical goods classification
patterns.fix: Digital goods and subscriptions must use Apple's In-App Purchase. External links for digital purchases will be rejected.

patterns.title: Photo Library Access Without Purpose
patterns.description: App requests photo library access without a clear user-facing feature
detection: Check for NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription in Info.plist
Verify the usage string explains the specific feature
Flag if photo access seems unrelated to app purpose
patterns.fix: Only request photo library access if your app has a clear feature requiring it. Use PHPickerViewController for limited access when possible.

patterns.title: Missing Age Rating Configuration
patterns.description: App doesn't properly configure age rating or content is inappropriate for selected rating
detection: Check Info.plist for content rating keys
Compare app content with declared age rating
Look for mature content in apps rated 4+
patterns.fix: Set the correct age rating in App Store Connect that matches your app's actual content.

patterns.title: Microphone Access Without Justification
patterns.description: App requests microphone permission without clear audio-related feature
detection: Check for NSMicrophoneUsageDescription in Info.plist
Verify app has audio recording, voice chat, or similar feature
Flag if microphone seems unrelated to app purpose
patterns.fix: Only request microphone access for features that genuinely require audio input. Explain the specific use case.

patterns.title: Bluetooth Usage Without Explanation
patterns.description: App requests Bluetooth permission without clear peripheral interaction
detection: Check for NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription in Info.plist
Verify app actually interacts with Bluetooth peripherals
patterns.fix: Only request Bluetooth access if your app connects to Bluetooth devices. Clearly explain which devices.

patterns.title: Non-Standard UI Patterns
patterns.description: App uses non-standard navigation or UI that confuses users
detection: Check for custom navigation that differs from iOS conventions
Look for non-standard gesture handlers that may conflict with system gestures
patterns.fix: Follow Apple's Human Interface Guidelines for navigation patterns and standard UI components.

patterns.title: Minimum Deployment Target Too Low
patterns.description: App targets a very old iOS version that may not be testable
detection: Check MinimumOSVersion in Info.plist
Check IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET in project.pbxproj
Flag if targeting iOS versions below 15
patterns.fix: Update your minimum deployment target to a recent iOS version (iOS 16+ recommended as of 2026).

patterns.title: HealthKit Usage Without Privacy Safeguards
patterns.description: App uses HealthKit but doesn't properly protect health data
detection: Check for HealthKit entitlement
Verify NSHealthShareUsageDescription and NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription
Check privacy policy covers health data
patterns.fix: Ensure health data is handled with appropriate safeguards and clearly declared in your privacy policy.
